//: The one list of what goes into the packed file, read by BOTH build.mjs and build.py. Order matters: each blob is its files concatenated in this order, in one scope. guard.js is first in pk-app so the error boundary is up before anything else runs; harden.js is last in pk-app so it can wrap what the others defined; ds.css is last in pk-css so the design system has the final word. pk-ast (the GENERATED font library and preloaded markups — tools/addfonts.py, tools/addmarkups.py) runs last, after the app is up. pk-ws (the WORKSPACE: tabs, RFDS mode, alignment — GENERATED by tools/addworkspace.py from src/workspace/) and pk-rfds (the RFDS Redlining Tool build, patched — GENERATED by tools/embed_rfds.py from assets/rfds/) are never run by the boot loader: the workspace starts from pk-ws when the page is opened directly, and inflates pk-rfds into a frame per RFDS tab. A blob entry may carry a third element, attributes for its <script> tag.
